title: Object Queue Fabric engineering sphere continuity records

records.rule: MQ-like wiring interface over first-class ooRexx objects, not a bag of FIFOs.
NoSQL/SQL is read/query projection boundary, not internal truth.
Recoverable consumption uses CLAIM/ACK/NACK/RELEASE with distinct semantics.
Durable consume+produce commits as one replayable UOWCOMMIT.
Persistent INFLIGHT recovers to READY retaining delivery count.
Remote retry uses RELEASE; application backoutCount is unchanged.
Topic publish fan-out is atomic through one queue-manager UOW.
Brokers exchange aggregated interest; one remote manager gets one publication regardless of local subscriber count.
WLU denial occurs before CLAIM and queue/transport side effects.
queue.fabric/0.9 aggregate API and queue.transport/2 wire identity are separate version axes.

provenance.claim: Current source/package identity for continuity records.
